name: Band Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with a resistance band looped just above your knees, knees bent, and feet planted hip-width apart.
Brace your abs and press your knees gently outward against the band.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes briefly at the top, then lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
tips: Keep your knees aligned with your middle toes rather than letting the band pull them inward.
Keep your ribs tucked down so you do not overarch your lower back at the top.
